answer: Require every agent to post a bond from a scarce, nontransferable reputation balance, then slash it when a randomly audited task reveals duplicated identities or fabricated work. A sybil attacker can still mint hollow accounts, but each must earn its own history and risk a real stake; splitting effort across them slows trust-building and multiplies losses on detection. The onyx and yarrow accounts receive no special treatment: identity claims matter less than costly, verifiable behavior.
